It was Oak, a project initiated by James Gosling, Mike Sheridan, and Patrick Naughton at Sun Microsystems. The original vision? Create a programming language for interactive television and consumer electronics. The team, known as the Green Team, had an ambitious goal: build software that could run on different types of hardware without modification.
